body: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we reveal that quantization sensitivity is both taskand time-dependent, with different downstream tasks exhibiting distinct precision requirements across denoising steps. We further show that these patterns can be predicted without groundtruth labels or task-specific evaluation metrics. Building on these findings, we introduce T 2Quant, a task and time-aware mixedprecision quantization framework that uses a label-free sensitivity signal to optimally allocate activation precision across denoising steps under a fixed bit-width budget. Extensive experiments across three DLMs and six benchmarks demonstrate that T 2Quant consistently improves the average accuracy of existing quantization methods, achieving gains of up to 6.7 percentage points under the same budget.
summaryZh: 不同的任务，不同的时间步长：扩散语言模型的时间任务感知量化。扩散语言模型（DLM）由于其迭代去噪过程而引入了独特的量化挑战。在这项工作中，我们揭示了量化灵敏度既依赖于任务又依赖于时间，不同的下游任务在去噪步骤中表现出不同的精度要求。
